point1.description: Complete activities set by {{country; vn:Fastlance; default:Fastwork}} to earn points instantly! (Freelancers can earn points from sales.)

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: How to join {{country; vn:Fastlance; default:Fastwork}} Rewards?

a1.item1: Just log in to {{country; vn:Fastlance; default:Fastwork}} and go to "Missions" page to start earning points and redeem exclusive rewards. If you encounter any issues, please contact our help center.

faq.q2: How do I earn points in the program?

a2.item1: Complete activities listed on the Missions page, like daily check-ins.
a2.item2: Special for freelancers: Earn 1 point for every {{value}} from approved jobs.

faq.q3: What are the benefits of {{country; vn:Fastlance; default:Fastwork}} Rewards?

a3.item1:
Examples include: 
• Cashback for freelancers
• special discounts for clients
• Exclusive rewards
• Discount coupons from partners
• Access to {{country; vn:Fastlance; default:Fastwork}} events
• And more

Remark: Benefits may change over time based on user needs.

faq.q4: Do Points in the {{country; vn:Fastlance; default:Fastwork}} Rewards Program expire?

a4.item1: {{country; vn:Fastlance; default:Fastwork}} Points expire 3 months after earned, at the end of the third month (e.g., Points earned in January expire on April 30).
a4.item2: The system will always use the Points that expire soonest first.
